assessment_objectives.objective: hybrid/composite algorithms are leveraged as a transition path to Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) solutions, where applicable.
solutions support hybrid signatures (e.g., ECDSA + ML-DSA) and hybrid Key Encapsulation Mechanisms (KEMs) (e.g., ECDH + ML-KEM).
certificate formats, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and trust anchors can support dual-key or dual-certificate models.
plans exist for eventual removal of classical algorithms once PQC confidence is sufficient.
